description: Put one of the developer's delisted Caps back online. There is no review: if the connection hasn't changed since it was delisted it goes live immediately. If the service address did change, it is retested first and the call fails with the test result until the new address passes. Needs the developer's Qumge key.

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: relist_cap
